title: docs: the provider lists in README, docs/PRD.md and the VS Code listing name GitHub Copilot CLI
description:
Slice 6 of task-59e1d150 (GitHub Copilot CLI as a fifth agent provider). dependsOn task-d609eae3 (JetBrains) and task-7739d4af (VS Code), because this text says both IDEs offer Copilot.

DELIVERABLE (text only):
- README.md names GitHub Copilot CLI in the intro sentence, the works-with badge, the "Your choice of coding CLI" row, the install prerequisites and the account-rotation note (Copilot seats, like Codex, Antigravity and Grok seats, are unaffected). It also gains one line on installing and signing in (npm install -g @github/copilot, then copilot login, once in Windows and once in WSL), placed like the Grok Build line.
- docs/PRD.md names it in the provider lists (about :12 and :21), and the row at about :240 that calls Copilot "Autocomplete only" describes the agent provider.
- moe-vscode/package.json's description and moe-vscode/README.md (intro, prerequisites, feature list) name it.
- packages/moe-proxy/src/utils.ts: the injectWorkerType doc comment lists COPILOT among the daemon's worker types (it reads "CLAUDE, CODEX, GEMINI or GROK" today).

NOT IN SCOPE: scripts/CLAUDE.md, docs/CONFIGURATION.md and docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md (the closing row task-59e1d150 writes them with its signed-in smoke facts); plugin.xml (task-d609eae3); any behavior change.

VERIFICATION: npm run lint at the repo root, plus one grep the plan names showing each listed file names Copilot and PRD.md no longer says "Autocomplete only" for it.
definitionOfDone: README.md names GitHub Copilot CLI in the intro, the works-with badge, the provider row, the prerequisites and the account-rotation note, and has one install-and-sign-in line for copilot
docs/PRD.md names it in its provider lists, and its Copilot row no longer says 'Autocomplete only'
moe-vscode/package.json's description and moe-vscode/README.md name GitHub Copilot CLI
npm run lint passes at the repo root
